sections.title: General
items: All prices are in JPY and include the lesson and a post-lesson learning summary.
In-person lessons are available in Shibuya, Tamachi, and Shinagawa. Contact me for details or if you'd like to meet elsewhere.

sections.title: Discounts
items: FIRST20: 20% off your first 1:1 lesson.
FIRST20 is not valid for package or plan purchases.

sections.title: 8-Lesson Package
items: Valid for 240 days from purchase date.
One lesson credit is used per lesson attended, or if you cancel within 24 hours of the start time.
Rescheduling allowed up to 24 hours before the lesson.
Package credits are non-transferable.
Refundable within 48 hours of purchase if unused; refund minus ¥1,500 admin fee.
After 48 hours or once any lesson is used: non-refundable.

sections.title: Monthly Member Plan
items: The Monthly Member Plan is a ¥20,000 per month subscription that includes one 60-minute lesson every week.
This works out to approximately 4-5 lessons per month (depending on how many weeks are in the month), at roughly ¥4,600 per hour.
The plan auto-renews every month until you cancel.
Cancel anytime before your next billing date via the Stripe customer portal or by contacting me. Your plan remains active until the end of the current paid month.
Unused hours roll over to the next month, up to a maximum of 4 rollover hours.
Members can book additional lessons at the discounted rate of ¥4,500 per hour.
First-time subscribers: if you request cancellation within 24 hours of subscribing and no lessons have been taken, you'll receive a full refund for that month.
After 24 hours, or once any lesson has been taken, the current month is non-refundable.

sections.title: Cancellation — Single Lessons
items: Cancel more than 48 hours before: refund minus a ¥500 admin fee (or free reschedule).
Cancel 24–48 hours before: 50% refund.
Cancel within 24 hours or after the lesson: no refund (except for service issues on my end).

sections.title: Payment
items: Online lessons: please pay within 24 hours of booking to confirm your spot (payment link provided by email).
In-person lessons: pay online in advance or in cash on the day.
